_about: Bands of the vital signs. Every band must carry a source: where the threshold comes from. A band without a source, or with status reference, has no right to paint a vital red: it is printed as a reference. inclusive=true means that equality with the threshold is already outside the band (V14: a Brier score of exactly 0.25 is a coin flip). IMPORTANT: all numeric thresholds were calibrated on the history of ONE user; treat them as starting points and recalibrate on your own ledger.

V1_accepted.source: at least one deliverable accepted by the owner per window (a north-star counter); only trusted verdict sources count (tg, owner, owner-file)

V2_verified_done.source: no norm established; reference only; verified counts only when verify is ok for every predicate under the contract hash

V3_evidence_ratio.source: principle: a claim without evidence is not a claim; the threshold is reference until both ends are measured

V4_tokens_per_hour.source: no norm established; the baseline from your own history (median and p90) is printed instead

V5_flood_share.source: one user's audit: oversized results filled most of the context window; the threshold is reference, awaiting measurement at both ends

V6_tool_error_rate.source: no norm established; baseline from your own history

V7_loops_per_100.source: no norm established; baseline from your own history

V8_blind_edit_rate.source: Claude Code's own rule: Edit without a prior Read is refused; any blind edit is a defect; the denominator is distinct edited files

V9_stall_minutes.source: a session that gets no permission within 30 minutes should mark the step and move on; the value is the union of waits over 30 min, any such wait is a WARN

V10_fanout_turns.source: observed on one account: waves of parallel subagents burned the plan limits; a fan-out (4+ Agent calls in one model message) without a stated reason is an incident

V11_owner_repeat_share.source: one operator measured about 19 % of their messages as repeated orders and called that a disease; 5 % is a reference target until the healthy end is measured

V12_repeat_incident_share.source: principle: a repeat of a defect class is a stop line; the 0.2 threshold is reference

V13_layer_tax_ms.source: one user's audit: six processes of 110-155 ms on every Write; a 500 ms per-call threshold is reference

V14_calibration_brier.source: the size of a calibration shift is demonstrable from about 8 points (a permutation test on one history); a Brier score of 0.25 is a coin flip, equality is already outside the band; a share of p in 0.45..0.55 of 50 % or more means NO DATA

V13_layer_tax_ms.source: benchmark on one machine: the adapter's own work is 25-47 ms, of which detectors are 0.03 ms and the rest is locking and the ledger fsync. The full call is measured separately: a 250 ms median threshold on a machine whose empty `python -S -E` process costs 87 ms; a 100 ms target is unreachable because the interpreter costs 70 ms and `import json` another 40 ms. Two numbers instead of one.
